title: CVE-2026-93630 — Zimbra Collaboration Suite Email HTML Sanitizer Bypass via Hostname Canonicalization
summary: Affected: Zimbra Collaboration Suite A hostname canonicalization vulnerability in the email HTML sanitizers of Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an unauthenticated sender to bypass the restriction on forms that target the Zimbra host. DefangFilter and the OWASP ActionAttributePolicy compare the form-action hostname with the request hostname before browser URL canonicalization. A percent-encoded hostname can therefore survive sanitization while the browser submits the form to the normal Zimbra origin with the recipient's authentication cookie. This permits authenticated form requests from a crafted email after the recipient opens it in Classic and submits the form. The issue is present in ZCS 10.1.16 and 10.1.21. It does not bypass an endpoint's CSRF-token checks; a state-changing attack additionally requires an endpoint that accepts the resulting request without that protection.

title: CVE-2026-120404 — Apache OpenNLP: Denial of service via inefficient regular expression in the coordinate name finder
summary: Affected: Apache Software Foundation Apache OpenNLP The built-in regular expression name finder for latitude and longitude coordinates uses a pattern that is vulnerable to excessive backtracking. An attacker who can supply text that an application analyzes with this name finder can cause high CPU consumption, leading to denial of service. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.5.13 or 3.0.0, which fix the issue.

title: CVE-2026-21607
summary:
Affected: Atlassian Jira Software Data Center This High severity Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability known as CVE-2026-21607 was introduced in versions 10.3.26 and 11.3.12.

This Path Traversal (Arbitrary Read/Write) vulnerability, with a CVSS Score of 8.7 and a CVSS Vector of CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose protected web application files outside the intended resource location, which has high impact to confidentiality, no impact to integrity, no impact to availability, and requires no user interaction.

Atlassian recommends that Jira Software Data Center customers upgrade to the latest version. If you are unable to do so, upgrade your instance to one of the specified supported fixed versions:

Jira Software Data Center 11.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 11.3.13
Jira Software Data Center 10.3: Upgrade to a release greater than or equal to 10.3.27

See the release notes (https://confluence.atlassian.com/jirasoftware/jira-software-data-center-release-notes.html). You can download the latest version of Jira Software Data Center from the Jira Data Center Download Archives (https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/download-archives).

title: CVE-2026-21600
summary:
